Supports close to 3,000 conversions! ... **Transmute** is a free, open-source, self-hosted file conversion and compression tool built for privacy and automation. Convert images, video, audio, documents, spreadsheets, subtitles, and fonts entirely locally, or compress supported files to make them smaller without sending anything to a third…

name: Umbrel (umbrelOS)
description: Umbrel is a small device that sits in your home and lets you store your files, stream your media, run your own AI, and much more. All the convenience of the cloud, but your data stays with you. You access it from any device (phone, tablet, or computer) right in your browser. ... umbrelOS is the operating system that powers every Umbrel — think macOS or Windows, but for your home server. It's designed to be simple…

name: Uptime Kuma
description: Uptime Kuma — self-hosted uptime/status monitoring.

name: ValorGrid
description: Add ValorGrid to the CasaOS AppStore. ... ValorGrid is a private, single-user local portfolio dashboard with SQLite persistence, local backups, and portfolio views for holdings, allocation, movements, monthly tracking, and history. Set an auth password (params); add an Alpha Vantage API key for live market prices.

name: Vaultwarden
description: Vaultwarden — lightweight Bitwarden-compatible password manager server.

name: Videola
description: Videola — a browser-based video editor on a Rust core: import, cut and trim on the timeline, effects, transitions, masks, keyframes, colour scopes, an audio mixing desk with EBU R128 loudness, subtitles and export. Works on desktop, tablet and phone, and ships an HTTP API plus an MCP server for agents. The editor opens without a login; the API and the server-side storage root need the access token below.

name: Vikunja
description: Vikunja — self-hosted to-do / task & project management. CORS disabled (single container); runs as root so it can create its files dir (image runs as uid 1000 but /app/vikunja is root-owned).

name: wallabag
description: wallabag — save and read articles later, ad-free (the self-hosted Pocket). Runs on SQLite in a single container. First login: wallabag / wallabag — change it right away.

name: Wallos
description: Wallos — self-hosted subscription tracker & budget overview (SQLite).

name: WebDataStudio
description: WebDataStudio — a database studio that runs in the browser: PostgreSQL, MySQL/MariaDB, SQL Server, SQLite, Oracle, DuckDB, ClickHouse, MongoDB and Redis in one container. Schema explorer, SQL editor with completion and history, a visual query builder, result charts, ER diagrams, schema editing and comparison between connections, saved and scheduled queries, an administration surface and an MCP endpoint for AI agents. Connections are added in the studio or passed in as WDS_CONN_<NAME> variables. Set the admin account below — with no user and password there is no login screen at all, so never publish it without one. Building a stack instead? Add WebDataStudio to a database resource in the builder and the connection is wired for you.

name: Whisper ASR
description: Whisper ASR web service — speech-to-text HTTP API (openai-whisper / faster-whisper).

name: Whoogle
description: Whoogle — private, ad-free Google search proxy (no JS, no tracking).

name: Wiki.js
description: Wiki.js — modern, powerful wiki. Postgres companion included.

name: WordPress
description: WordPress — the classic PHP blog/CMS (official Apache image). Comes with a MariaDB companion; the famous five-minute install runs in the browser on first visit.

name: Yuvomi
description: Yuvomi — self-hosted family planner as a fast PWA: shared calendar (CalDAV/Google/ICS sync), tasks, shopping lists, meal planner, contacts, budget and housekeeping. Create the first household in the browser after install.
